comprehensive.Benefit exclusions: Regular dental check-ups, glasses and physiotherapy are not covered. You pay for those yourself. Dental surgery in hospital is different and part of that is covered.
comprehensive.Medical cover: At a Direct Billing doctor you usually pay nothing at the time. At other doctors you pay the full amount and claim part of it back. Find a Direct Billing doctor in the app before you book.
comprehensive.Waiting periods: Most things you can use straight away. Doctor visits, medicines, ambulance and mental health have no wait. If you already had signs of a health problem before your cover started, you may wait 12 months.
comprehensive.Making a claim: Claim in the app or in Online Member Services. You need the itemised receipt from the provider.
comprehensive.Ambulance services: Emergency ambulance is covered anywhere in Australia. There is no limit. You do not have to wait.
comprehensive.Mental health support: Yes. We pay towards each psychology and counselling session, up to an annual limit. The free 24 hour line can also connect you to someone now.
comprehensive.Activating your cover: Sign up for Online Member Services at medibankoshc.com.au. It takes about two minutes. Benefits cannot be paid until you have arrived in Australia and activated your cover.
comprehensive.Prescription medicines: You pay a set amount per prescription and we cover the rest, up to an annual limit. Your remaining balance is on the home screen.
